name: Dotquad Lite
summary: Your public IP, where it appears, and if it's a VPN
description:
Dotquad Lite shows your Mac's public IP on the shelf: where it appears to be, the network that owns it, and whether it's a VPN or hosting address. Copy the IP with one click, or open it on dotquad.app for the full lookup.

It adds a Command Center tile with your IP and a VPN dot, and two tools for AI apps through Droppy's MCP server: my_public_ip and am_i_on_vpn.

Nothing is sent until you turn lookups on. After that, Dotquad Lite asks dotquad.app only while the widget or tile is on screen, at most once every 5 minutes and once after the network changes. Nothing about you is stored, on your Mac or on the server, beyond a count of requests.

capabilityReasons.network-client: Sends your public IP to dotquad.app to look up its location and network, after you turn lookups on.
capabilityReasons.menu-bar: Shows your IP and VPN status as a Command Center tile.
capabilityReasons.clipboard-write: Copies your IP when you press Copy.
capabilityReasons.notch-banner: Shows a banner when your public or local IP changes, or your VPN turns off or on, if you turn those alerts on.
